settings.inlineButtons: Show an inline ⬇ download button on media messages
settings.previews: Also show it on channel/invite preview images
settings.previewsHint: Off by default. The photo on a join card, link preview, or "channel photo changed" notice isn't message content.
settings.webm: Also show the download button on GIFs and animated stickers (WebM)
settings.webmHint: Off by default. GIFs and stickers are usually decorative, not something you want to save.
settings.zipDefault: Zip downloads into one file by default
settings.zipHint: Applies to both the Download and Channel tabs. Zipping fetches every file into memory before saving, so very large batches will be slower and use more RAM than individual downloads.
